'''Deladrin''' was a [[Tarabon]]er noblewoman who served as [[Panarch]].

== History ==
Deladrin hardly ever agreed with King [[Andric]], and there was usually strife between the two co-rulers of the nation.

As a result, [[Darkfriends]] manipulated Andric into agreeing to the murder of Panarch Deladrin. [[Jaichim Carridin]] hoped to pin the assassination of [[Arad Doman]] in order to stir tensions in [[Tarabon]] where the [[Children of the Light]] could intervene and take near total control of the nation.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>

She was eventually assassinated by the [[Black Ajah]].

Her successor was Andric's lover, [[Amathera Aelfdene Casmir Lounault]], who was raised to the position even though she was rejected by the [[Assembly of Lords]].
